title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When we talk about bias in a model, we're referring to the error introduced by approximating a real-world problem, which may be complex, by a simplified model. Reducing bias often involves making the model more flexible. Can you think of how this might affect the variance?

title: Exploring Model Flexibility
text: If a model becomes more flexible, it can fit the training data more closely. This might reduce bias, but what could be the trade-off in terms of variance?

title: Impact on Variance
text: What happens to the variance of a model when it becomes more flexible?
